candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (DependencyUnavailable) in inventory, propagating 503 from /v1/reservations and ReadTimeout 502s up through order to gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No redis-side metrics/logs; root cause of the redis timeout (saturation vs network) is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts causing inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout 502s across all correlated requests; logs and metrics corroborate ~2s checkout latency and 502s. Bounded to redis-timeout; redis-side cause unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Redis server metrics (latency, connections, saturation) to confirm the timeout origin
Inventory service logs/metrics for the reserve_inventory dependency call
